Title: To be or not to be a discipline (Striga)

Messages.Author: Jesper
Messages.Body:
According the rules ”In many cases, a minion card will have a Discipline symbol, a clan symbol and/or a blood cost; in these cases, the card can only be played by a vampire who meets the requirements.”

The symbol to the left on e.g. Strix looks like a discipline, and since there only can be discipline, clan or cost in the left column, can can a vampire with Infernal pact play Strix on superior?

There is not a bold text on top of the card saying that "Striga" is not a disciplin. It only write so at the inferior level.

Nothing on Strix at Surperior says that Striga isent a Disciplin
Nothing in the rules say it isent a disciplin (since the rule do not says what disciplins there are)

I am not talking about the inferior version, becouse thats a different discussion.

---- References ----
Strix
+1 intercept, even if intercept is not yet needed. If this vampire successfully blocks this action, he or she untaps at the end of the action.  is not a Discipline.

Only usable when a bleed against you is successful. The bleed burns no pool. Instead, this vampire taps and enters combat with the acting minion.

infernal pact
Unique master.
Put this card on a Tremere antitribu you control and choose a Discipline. The vampire with this card can play cards that require that Discipline as though he or she has the superior version of that Discipline

Maleficia and Striga are disciplines, as per the rules:

vekn.net/card-lists/143-heirs-to-the-blood

> Maleficia and Striga: Two new Disciplines that are only available to infernal vampires. The same way that Caitiff is not a clan, these are not true Disciplines, however (so just like "Caitiff" cannot be chosen for Consanguineous Boon, Ian Forestal couldn't use his ability to meet a Striga requirement, for example, nor could Maleficia be chosen as one of the Great Beast's Disciplines).
